key_points: BMO and Sun Life pledged C$75 billion of private capital for Canadian infrastructure over the next decade.
BMO announced a C$70 billion commitment to new spending aimed at boosting key Canadian industries.
Bank of Montreal listed HKD 850 million senior notes on the London market, a routine funding operation.
BMO reduced its stake in Lululemon, reflecting portfolio rebalancing amid share‑price pressure.
Broader headlines warn of an escalating U.S.–Canada trade war that could weigh on Canadian financials.
